description: This file defines the class `SugarCacheZend`, which implements cache functionality using Zend shared memory cache within the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM system. It extends `SugarCacheAbstract` and provides methods to store, retrieve, clear, and reset cache entries using external Zend cache functions.

classes.name: SugarCacheZend
classes.description: A cache class that utilizes Zend shared memory cache for external caching, extending `SugarCacheAbstract` and implementing methods to interface with Zend's cache functions.

methods.name: useBackend
methods.description: Determines whether the Zend shared memory cache backend should be used based on availability and configuration.

methods.name: _setExternal
methods.description: Stores a key-value pair in the Zend shared memory cache, serializing the value.

methods.name: _getExternal
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the Zend shared memory cache by key, unserializing it if necessary.

methods.name: _clearExternal
methods.description: Deletes a cache entry from the Zend shared memory cache by key.

methods.name: _resetExternal
methods.description: Clears all entries from the Zend shared memory cache.
